notes.title: KRAI MIRA: EXTENDED CUT
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10401492/707f751ffd57585b7f4d6e9fbe784a888331c850.jpg[/img]

This old-school production by TallTech Studio, styled after the genre’s classics, is getting a spectacular amount of improvements thanks to this special version of the game.
- interactive help and tips
- improved inventory and UI
- new items, including high level armor and advanced cures
- new random encounters
- new localizations (French, Polish, and German), new dialogues
- improved AI
- new locations: the monastery, catacombs, “Lake” laboratory complex, ancient ruins, and more
- bug fixes
- option to continue your adventure after completing the main quest
- 3 different game endings

notes.title: Easter edition
notes.content:
+ New locations: Terminal, Dead City, Otrog labs, Foreland, Meganome, Lone Island
+ 16 new random locations and random mob groups
+ Global Map altered
+ Monsters: HomoDrill, PigBull, Ankor
+ New dialogues and NPCs
+ Armour: Dog Armour, Avia helmet, Tank helmet
+ Weapons: 'Drummer' pistol, self-made pistol, 'Hot spray' flamethrower, BabyGun, 'Cerber' crossbow, 8-arrow spring bow, 'Redding' and 'Scout' rifles, Ball minigun, Hydro Fist
+ Terrain objects (dead ships, crashed helicopter/plane, oil pump, ruined bridge, bikes, cars, boat wreck)
+ Blackjack mini game
+ Slot Machine mini game

[h1]Improvements:[/h1]
+ Inventory items sorting by type
+ GUI ('flying' damage points, coloured speech in scenarios, ammo reloaded from Inv)
+ Random locations and mobs depend on global Map coordinates
+ Radiation resistance for armour
+ 2X chances to hit trapped enemies in Aim weapon mode
+ Global map resize
+ V-Sync (option in Settings)
+ Post-Processing (option in Settings)

[h1]Bug fixed:[/h1]
+ Bug when player sometimes doesn't react on Loot
+ Distant weapon 'walking' bug
+ 'Evade with rifle' bug
